name.english: Income tax on compensation, computed from gross pay
name.filipino: Income tax sa sahod, kinukwenta mula sa gross pay
name.taglish: Income tax sa compensation, computed from gross pay

applies_to: Purely compensation earners (employees), not minimum wage earners. Taxable compensation = annual gross pay - mandatory employee contributions + 13th-month pay and other benefits in excess of the exclusion cap; then the graduated table for the same tax year (tax_rules/income_tax_graduated.json).

kb_references.title: Employee_Compensation_Tax_Reference
kb_references.what: Exclusions from taxable compensation: mandatory contributions (NIRC Sec. 32(B)(7)(f)) and 13th month pay and other benefits up to P90,000 (Sec. 32(B)(7)(e)); no personal or dependent exemptions (RA 10963 Sec. 12).

kb_references.title: BIR_Income_Tax_FAQ
kb_references.what: Exclusions from gross income include 13th month pay and other benefits not exceeding P90,000, and GSIS, SSS, Medicare and other contributions (Question 5).

label.filipino: TRAIN rules para sa kita mula sa sahod (taong 2018 pataas)
label.taglish: TRAIN rules para sa compensation income (tax years 2018 onwards)

versions.legal_basis: NIRC Sec. 32(B)(7)(e) as amended by RA 10963 (13th-month pay and other benefits excluded up to P90,000); NIRC Sec. 32(B)(7)(f) (GSIS, SSS, Medicare and Pag-ibig contributions excluded); RA 10963 Sec. 12 (repeal of personal and additional exemptions, NIRC Sec. 35); rates per Sec. 24(A)(2)(a)

sources.title: RA 10963 (TRAIN Law): Sec. 32(B)(7)(e) P90,000 ceiling; Sec. 12 repeal of Sec. 35
RA 8424 (NIRC of 1997), Sec. 32(B)(7)(f): GSIS, SSS, Medicare and Pag-ibig contributions, and union dues of individuals

verification.notes: periods_per_year is arithmetic (12 months, 24 half-months, 52 weeks), not a legal rate. Daily pay is deliberately not annualized: the number of paid days per year varies by employer, so the user is asked for a monthly or annual figure instead. Union dues are also excluded under Sec. 32(B)(7)(f) but are not computed; the user can include them in a manually entered contributions total.
